title: XMage bug: isFastFailInTestMode defaults to true for all players
description:
PlayerImpl.java sets isFastFailInTestMode = true by default. The error recovery code in GameImpl.java checks !isFastFailInTestMode(), so real games take the 'tests - try to fail fast' branch and kill the game thread on any card NPE instead of incrementing the error counter (up to 15 allowed errors) and continuing.

Test players are unaffected because GameImpl checks !isTestMode() first, which short-circuits for test players regardless of isFastFailInTestMode.

Fix: change default to false in PlayerImpl.java.
